companion.message: He walks, he sits, he drinks. Over and over. Right now it's the cask. And we're not leaving the miner.

stance.text: We take the miner with us.

companion.message: The rats down here are starving and very chatty.

actions.because: Under pressure he bargains once the drum is useless, and he fears being blamed more than anything.

narration.text: The doors swing open just as Snag's hand closes on an empty peg. He comes down the corridor with his club up, finds three loose prisoners and a miner, and spins for the drum. Its head is in tatters. "Uzga'll skin me either way," he says.
texture: Snag's club is a table leg wrapped in rusted wire.

moment.reply: Snag squints at you over his bones. "Ale crawl? Never heard of it." His eyes flick to the cask.
learned: Snag glanced at the cask when you mentioned a way out.

check.reason: Bribes work in the Maw and he's scared of Uzga, but he doesn't trust you yet.

on_success.text: "Tie me up proper," he mutters. "Make it look like I fought. Then I'll show you something."

on_failure.text: "Nice try." He shifts his grip on the club.
